name: Stage Control Plus
author: marcho78, kristofferR, edree0x
description: Organize your desktops from one view. Swipe up with four fingers (or press Super+A) and every window steps onto a live stage, under a bar of all your desktops with live thumbnails. Drag windows between desktops; add, remove, reorder and rename them. Type to search, press Space for a Quick Look, Tab to switch between this desktop and every desktop, choose one display or all, and click to close windows. Liquid Glass styling, configurable hot corners, and a settings window.

barWidget.description: Stage Control Plus. Click for settings, right-click to open the stage, middle-click for the current app's windows.
